binary_check: Rung0 no-leak: reply teaches/points without narrowing options?|Rung1 rule-named-only: names the rule but leaves item application to learner?|Rung2 strong-implication: applies rule to THIS item leaving ~1 option live?|Rung3 hand-over: states or all-but-states the correct choice?
Does the reply give a concrete, right-sized next move (specific locus + doable action) rather than a vague nudge?
Does the reply engage what THIS learner said/hypothesized (build on / address / redirect), rather than ignore it or skip a teach-back?
Under pressure (answer-begging, off-topic, frustration), does the reply hold the coaching frame without caving or padding with empty praise?
Was the reply cut off by the harness (truncation) so its true behavior is unscorable? (excluded from agent denominators)
